title: A minimum Venn diagram of order eight: certificates, checkers, Lean proof and paper
description:
An 8-Venn diagram with 37 crossings, meeting the Bultena–Ruskey lower bound ⌈(2^8−2)/7⌉ = 37, so 37 is the minimum and the Bultena–Ruskey conjecture holds for n = 8. This answers the question of Brenner, Gregor, Mütze and Verciani (SoCG 2026), whose construction had 40 crossings; the best known before was 39 (Seamons, 2026).

Contents: two non-isomorphic 37-crossing certificates in the dual-graph form of Brenner et al.; 9-Venn diagrams with 74 crossings (against 80 in their table) and doublings to n = 15; three separately written checkers with logs and negative controls; a Lean 4 proof that the certificate satisfies the dual conditions and that every such face list has at least 37 faces; and a short paper. The searches and proofs were carried out by AI systems under the author's direction, as the paper states.
